description:
Import an allowlisted Viridis Security result receipt exactly once.

    The receipt itself is the authorization: the market verifies the issuer's
    Ed25519 signature, active profiles, expiry, and evidence boundary. Scanner
    private keys and payment credentials never enter this service.

receipt.description: The signed receipt object exactly as issued by the allowlisted issuer.
receipt.title: Receipt

signature_b64.description: URL-safe base64 Ed25519 signature over the receipt, from its issuer.
signature_b64.title: Signature B64

name: import_security_receipt

outputSchema.description: Stable result envelope advertised to MCP clients and registries.
outputSchema.title: MarketToolResult
